create_quant_fp8_class: create a QuantFP8 custom op for per-tensor, per-token, per-channel, or per-group FP8 quantization
run_forward_cuda: run forward_cuda to quantize a torch tensor to FP8 using CUDA custom ops with static or dynamic scales
run_forward_hip: run forward_hip to quantize a torch tensor to FP8 on ROCm using aiter ops or native fallback
run_forward_native: run forward_native to quantize a torch tensor to FP8 using pure PyTorch operations
test_quantize_group_native: test _quantize_group_native to quantize a tensor to FP8 with per-group scale computation
